summary.intent: Fix a failing lint CI check on PR #455 caused by a pnpm/action-setup dependency bump, and fix a separate Windows Rust build failure on PR #456.
summary.outcome: Diagnosed that action-setup@v6 was silently installing pnpm 11-rc instead of pnpm 10, fixed it by adding `packageManager: pnpm@10.33.0` to package.json and removing the conflicting `version: 10` workflow inputs. Also fixed a Rust borrow checker error in the Windows fuse platform code. Both fixes were committed and pushed.

repo: pnpm/action-setup@v6 prioritizes the `packageManager` field in package.json over the `version:` workflow input — and errors if both are present
action-setup@v6 was silently installing pnpm 11-rc (store/v11) despite `version: 10` being specified, because pnpm 11-rc satisfies the `^10` range or similar resolution logic
The shared crates/fuse/src/dir_ops.rs scopes inode inside a block to drop the borrow before mutable access; the Windows-specific dir_ops.rs did not follow this pattern
FileAttrs derives Clone, enabling the extract-then-drop fix for the borrow checker issue
pnpm 11 treats ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS as a hard error (exit 1); pnpm 10 only warned
onlyBuiltDependencies in package.json was missing @nestjs/core and @scarf/scarf from its allowlist

code.finding: inode held an immutable borrow of fs across a mutable borrow (refreshing_metadata.insert on line 62). Fixed by extracting parent_ino, children, and inode_attr then calling drop(inode) before the mutable borrow.
Shared dir_ops.rs correctly scopes inode inside a block (lines 33-61) so it is dropped before the mutable borrow on line 65 — the Windows override missed this pattern.
parent_inode is already scoped inside a block (lines 120-144) and dropped before the mutable access on line 147 — no borrow issue here.

workflow: CI store path in logs is a reliable indicator of actual pnpm version installed (v10 store = pnpm 10, v11 store = pnpm 11)
When action-setup conflicts arise, compare a passing run vs. a failing run's store path to detect silent version changes
pnpm 11 was only RC at the time; updating to it would have required Node >= 22.13
Worktrees (cipher-box-pr455) were used to isolate PR branch work from the main checkout

friction: action-setup@v6 silently installed pnpm 11-rc despite `version: 10` being specified, causing a hard-to-diagnose mismatch between local (pnpm 10) and CI (pnpm 11)
Multiple abortive fix attempts: onlyBuiltDependencies already existed but was incomplete; pnpm 11 upgrade was explored and then abandoned when it turned out to be pre-release only
action-setup@v6 throws an error when both `version:` input and `packageManager` field are present, requiring removal of version inputs from all workflow files after the packageManager fix was applied
Needed to update six separate workflow files for the pnpm version fix, with no shared reference
PR #455 lint fix was interrupted mid-execution when PR #456 Windows build failure came in
open_items: PR #455 version input removal was interrupted — the `version: 10` lines still need to be removed from all six workflow files after the packageManager field was added
PR #455 lint fix was not fully verified to pass CI before context switched to PR #456
pnpm 11 migration deferred — once pnpm 11 reaches stable, the project should migrate and re-evaluate the onlyBuiltDependencies list
